summary: Add public URL ISO downloads through Controller with durable Core execution. API impact: new contract for media/download and URL-bearing iso-import, gated by iso-download-v1.

guide.reason: ISO library offers computer upload or a public URL, with distinct transfer, validation and recovery behavior.

api.reason: New authenticated media/download operation and optional Media.url command field, with public destination validation, Core metadata and capability compatibility.

roadmap.reason: The existing ISO import item now includes the public URL source; the VM milestone remains in testing.

state.reason: Downloaded ISO content and metadata belong to the selected pool master; Controller only submits and mirrors host operations.
state.record: Pool master managed-VM journal stores original ISO command and resolved download metadata (identity, name, storage, size, SHA-256); selected storage nex-media contains the image. Applied managed inventory and enrollment/report adoption restore the same record on a fresh Controller.

verification.method: Focused Controller/Core tests, real Chromium interaction with explicitly mocked API, UI typecheck/build, API and documentation checks, and independent review; actual results and limits recorded in QA.
